name: numberverse
description: Numberverse — a math playground for kids 2–13. React+Phaser kid app, Next.js parent portal, react-admin console, FastAPI backend, Docker Postgres.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.build: pnpm --filter core build && pnpm --filter kid build && pnpm --filter parent build && pnpm --filter admin build
